Anytime-Valid ANOVA Table for an avlm Object

Source: R/av_anova.R
anova.avlm.Rd

Computes the sequential (Type I) ANOVA table of anova.lm and replaces its p-values with anytime-valid ones, using the same e-values as summary.avaov. Comparing several models (anova(fit1, fit2)) is not supported.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'avlm'
anova(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An avlm object.

...

Must be empty.

Value

An anova table with anytime-valid p-values.

Examples

anova(av(lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars), g = 1))
#> Analysis of Variance Table
#> 
#> Response: mpg
#> Anytime-valid p-values (g = 1)
#> 
#>           Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#> wt         1 847.73  847.73 126.041 4.411e-10 ***
#> hp         1  83.27   83.27  12.381   0.03364 *  
#> Residuals 29 195.05    6.73                      
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
